Short answer

To install omakade on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omakade. It is a 87.8 MB download (103.7 MB installed), version 1.16.2-1, licensed GPL-3.0-or-later, CC-BY-SA-3.0. A beautiful, local-first game library for Omarchy. Free and open source.

Install omakade on Omarchy

Omakade is a local-first game library for the Omarchy desktop that aggregates games you've installed across Steam, Lutris, Heroic, Faugus, RetroArch, Battle.net, Epic, GOG, and Amazon into a single cover-art browsing interface. It's built for keyboard and controller use, including a couch-mode layout, and stores everything locally rather than depending on a cloud service. It's an independent community project, not an official Omarchy app.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add omakade
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 1.16.2-1:
    pacman -Qi omakade

Open and use omakade

omakade is a desktop app. Press Super + Space to open the launcher and search for it. If it does not show up by name, list the desktop entries the package installed:

pacman -Ql omakade | grep applications

omakade requirements and compatibility

  • At least one supported game launcher (Steam, Lutris, Heroic, etc.) with installed games to display

Frequently asked questions

How do I install omakade on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add omakade. The download is 87.8 MB and it takes 103.7 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is omakade free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL-3.0-or-later, CC-BY-SA-3.0.

How do I uninstall omakade?

Run omarchy pkg drop omakade. It removes the package from your system.

What does omakade depend on?

The package declares 15 dependencies: glib2, hicolor-icon-theme, layer-shell-qt, libsecret, libzip, openssl, python, qt6-base, qt6-declarative, qt6-imageformats, qt6-svg, qt6-wayland and more. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is omakade a desktop app?

Yes. Open the launcher with Super + Space and search for omakade.

Is omakade in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as omakade (version 1.16.2-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. btsouth makes it. Project site: https://btsouth.github.io/omakade/.
